beads_commands.stdout_tail: Updated tdmem-0305: Create the memory evaluation and conformance crate

argv: Added the isolated provider-neutral memory conformance crate with exact identity fixtures, mandatory dummy-provider coverage, reusable scenario execution, differential terminal reports, and structurally isolated observer results.

Evidence: crates/tracedecay-memory-conformance depends only on tracedecay-memory-provider-api and is usable without the dashboard, host, fabric, Native adapter, NCM adapter, stores, or code index. FixtureIdentity pins the versioned canonical contract, contract-set digest, provider ID, provider build, and immutable implementation digest. MandatoryConformanceFixture enforces exact provider targets and fixed health/observe/recall slots. ConformanceHarness deterministically checks descriptor identity, mandatory capabilities, read-only handshake, health, observation acceptance, recall, terminal operation identity, and exact-scope digest. ProviderScenario and ScenarioRunner retain comparable typed terminal metadata and payload digests without provider state. DifferentialReport compares index-aligned external outcomes. ProductOutputDigest and ObserverConformanceResult make observer evidence incapable of carrying product-output bytes or replacing active output. The dummy-provider integration journeys pass mandatory conformance, expose a differential recall failure, and prove observer digest/report isolation. Validation branch run 33335324279 passed formatting, strict all-target Clippy, and focused tests before promotion; the serialized closure reruns those gates with the full M2 crate set and patch-policy checks.
